prompt: Complete EncryptedChannel, the top layer of a three-level channel hierarchy: its transform must call super.transform first so the compression runs before your Caesar shift, and its name must wrap the inherited one.
explanation: When every level of a hierarchy calls super before adding its own step, the overrides compose into a pipeline whose order is fixed by the inheritance chain rather than by the caller. The base class's send() calls transform() without knowing which override will answer, so dynamic dispatch runs the deepest version first and unwinds back down through each super call. Doing the work in that order matters: shifting the letters before the spaces are removed would give a different result.
hints: Start transform with String compressed = super.transform(message); and shift the characters of THAT string, not of the original message.
For a lower-case letter the shifted character is (char) ('a' + (c - 'a' + shift) % 26); the same pattern with 'A' handles upper case, and everything else is appended unchanged.
name() follows the same super pattern: "encrypted(" + super.name() + ")".
